title: Play a seed to the goal on the real game
description: Addresses, AOB signatures, detours, gates and detectors are only tested against fakes. Play a seed to its goal and compare the checks pzap sends with the ones the Python client sends on the same save.

title: First install on a real Windows game
description: Run pzap install against the real game: Steam detection, Oodle through oo2core_8_win64.dll, the .ovs files are present, and the ARCHIPELAGO ZOO career entry loads. Then pzap restore brings the game back to its original files. So far this is only tested against the cobra-tools fixtures.

title: Enable GitHub Pages
description: Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions (manual, by the repo owner), then rerun the pages job.

title: Launcher smoke test on Windows
description: Double-click opens the page; closing the console removes the patches; rundll32 opens the browser and steam:// links; PopTracker downloads and connects with --ap-host/--ap-slot; the page switches to French on a French browser.

title: Debug bundle
description: One zip with the log, the settings without the password, the install receipt and the game version.

title: Test mode with a fake room
description: A local fake Archipelago room to drive the client without a server, like the fakeroom in tf2-archipelago.

title: More goals in the apworld
description: M6: zoo rating, release X animals, breed X random species, research X species, with the matching detectors on the client side.

title: Generate the tracker's id mappings from gamedata
description: Write item_mapping.lua and location_mapping.lua from gamedata, plus a test that fails when the committed export is stale.
